content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QM Column 2

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 2:1 | "the heads of the camps-of the congregation" | "the heads of the camps of the congregation" | "the leaders of the congregational camps" | Structural | SOPHIA: follows LOGOS — preserves genitive chain |
| 2 | 2:2 | "who plunder-the-spoil" | "who plunder the spoil" | "collect the plunder" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "who collect the spoil" — compromise; "plunder" as verb too strong |
| 3 | 2:3 | "he-who-prepares the provisions" | "he who prepares the provisions" | "prepare the supplies" | Structural | SOPHIA: follows LOGOS — preserves singular participle |
| 4 | 2:3 | "when they go-forth from Jerusalem" | "when they march out from Jerusalem" | "once the troops march out from Jerusalem" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "when they march out from Jerusalem" — LOGOS phrasing preferred |
| 5 | 2:4 | "a man smitten with an uncleanness-of his flesh" | "a man afflicted with an impurity of his flesh" | "no man suffering from bodily impurity" | Structural | SOPHIA: "a man afflicted with a bodily impurity" — blends LOGOS and PNEUMA |
| 6 | 2:5 | "perfect-of spirit and flesh" | "perfect in spirit and body" | "sound in mind and body" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "sound in spirit and body" — PNEUMA's "sound" with LOGOS's "spirit" |
| 7 | 2:6 | "holy angels-are together with their armies" | "holy angels are present together with their armies" | "holy angels march alongside their armies" | Interpretive | SOPHIA: "holy angels are present together with their armies" — LOGOS; PNEUMA's "march" adds motion not in text |
| 8 | 2:7 | "the place-of the hand" | "the latrine" | "the latrine area" | Euphemism | SOPHIA: "the latrine" — EMET's Hebrew euphemism opaque in English |
| 9 | 2:7 | "unseemly nakedness-of anything" | "indecent nakedness" | "nothing indecent" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "nothing indecent" — PNEUMA's conciseness preferred here |
| 10 | 2:10 | "Called-ones-of God" | "Called of God" | "Called by God" | Inscription | SOPHIA: "Called of God" — LOGOS preserves Hebrew construct; PNEUMA adds "by" |
| 11 | 2:12 | "meeting-house" | "house of meeting" | "assembly hall" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "house of meeting" — echoes biblical 'ohel mo'ed pattern |
| 12 | 2:12 | "Testimonies-of God for the Holy-Council" | "Testimonies of God for the Holy Council" | "God's Decrees for the Sacred Council" | Inscription | SOPHIA: follows LOGOS — "Testimonies" closer to Hebrew 'edot |
| 13 | 2:14 | "a withdrawing-of covenant-faithfulness" | "a withdrawal of covenant faithfulness" | "to withdraw his faithful love" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "to withdraw covenant faithfulness" — verbal form clearer; keeps hesed rendering |
| 14 | 2:15 | "Formations-of the divisions-of God" | "Formations of the divisions of God" | "God's Ordered Divisions" | Inscription | SOPHIA: follows LOGOS — formal inscription register |
| 15 | 2:16 | "the men-of-the-infantry" | "the infantry" | "the foot soldiers" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "the infantry" — LOGOS concise and precise |

**Total disagreements: 15**
